title: DeepIndel: An Interpretable Deep Learning Approach for Predicting CRISPR/Cas9-Mediated Editing Outcomes
authors: Guishan Zhang, Huanzeng Xie, Xianhua Dai
relevance_to_cellguide: Repair-outcome/frameshift prediction model (Tier 2 in plan's roadmap, alongside Leenay/SPROUT). Trained and cross-validated on K562, HEK293T, AND a T-cell dataset (N=1603) — directly relevant to the plan's v4 'functional KO' stage, since it predicts frameshift frequency (not just indel%), and its cross-dataset generalization test (train K562+HEK293T, test on T cells) is a template for the plan's own gene/locus-held-out cross-cell-type validation.
